overview_description.description:
Imgur is an internet company that specializes in providing online entertainment for its users. Its platform offers internet, gifs, community, memes, visual storytelling, images, mobile, and native ads that helps people to unwind and have fun.

The company was founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.
